items.text:
For every good thing this game has going for it, it hinges comepletely on the player to not break the fragile mess this game is. 
The whole Oooh you are poor and have a lot of debt! Thing is going out the window after MAYBE 3rd salvage run if you are very unlucky.
Everything takes AGES to do, it's one of those games you can just leave running and go do something else while your guy/guys are fixing stuff up or whatever else as it takes so long. 
Almost and i mean like 60% of game's content is not explained and a lot of key features are straight up left unexplained, leaving you wasting hours getting a hang of core mechanics such as Long distance travel.
 
Orbital navigation is straight up obysmal. I grew up on KSP and THAT game is 3d, and this game does everything to make orbital navigation and maneuvers feel unresponsive, finicky and lacking in information. 
Aside from salvaging, which is something you always have to start with, there is mining, how do i know that? Because some documentation explains how to do that? Nope, it's because some dude is selling mining gear and how do i know how to mine? I guess better go to the discord! 

But that's not the main problem. Even in the KitFox advert they show that the entire game world is broken. You can just dock to people's ships, uninstall their fuel tanks and haul them back on your ship and nobody bats an eye. You can just break every station by just uninstalling the walls or just opening every airlock, killing everyone. I have to restrain myself because nobody will stop you from breaking the game, leaving you with just making money on repeat. 

And after all that this game comes out of early access? I regret buying this years ago thinking they will make something better.
items.text_zh:
这款游戏虽然有种种优点，但一切都完全取决于玩家不去破坏这个脆弱不堪的烂摊子。
所谓“哦你好穷啊还欠了一屁股债！”的设定，在你大概第三次打捞任务之后（如果你特别倒霉的话）就彻底形同虚设了。
做什么事都要花上老半天，这就是那种你可以直接让它挂着运行、自己去干别的事的游戏，因为你的角色/角色们修理东西或干其他什么事都要花太长时间。
游戏内容里几乎——我是说大约60%——都没有解释，很多关键功能干脆就完全没说明，让你白白浪费好几个小时才摸清核心机制，比如远距离航行。

轨道导航简直糟糕透顶。我是玩KSP长大的，那游戏可是3D的，而这款游戏想尽办法让轨道导航和机动操作感觉迟钝、别扭、信息匮乏。
除了打捞——这是你永远都得先做的事——还有采矿，我怎么知道有采矿的？因为有哪份文档解释了怎么采矿吗？没有，是因为有个家伙在卖采矿装备，那我又怎么知道怎么采矿？我猜最好还是去Discord问问吧！

但这还不是主要问题。就连KitFox的广告里都展示了整个游戏世界是崩坏的。你可以直接对接别人的飞船，拆下他们的燃料箱拖回自己船上，没人会眨一下眼。你可以直接拆掉墙壁或打开所有气闸来破坏每一个空间站，杀死所有人。我得克制自己，因为没人会阻止你破坏游戏，结果你就只能一遍遍重复赚钱。

经历了这一切之后，这游戏居然还脱离了抢先体验？我真后悔几年前买下它，还以为他们会做出更好的东西。

observations.description: 游戏世界是破碎的，可以随意对接他人船只、卸载燃料箱而不受惩罚。
